name: Galley
tagline: Prompt it. Proof it. Publish it.
description: Galley is an open-source AI CMS for static sites. Change a page in a form, on the page or by asking, check every change beside the live site, then publish it to your own git repository.

install.about: The one place the site's install commands come from. published is false until the first npm release; while it is false the site shows only the commands that work today (fromClone, and starterToday for the starters), and the build fails if a page would show create/createStarter/run.
